## Manufacturing][59]

Polar Specialized Industries (PSI) is proud to announce that we have officially received the ASME U2
Certificate of Authorization, marking a significant milestone in our commitment to engineering
excellence and safety.

[ [PSI Signs AED 6 Billion Framework Agreement with ADNOC] ][60]

## [PSI Signs AED 6 Billion Framework Agreement with ADNOC][61]

We’re proud to announce that Polar Specialized Industries (PSI) is among the 12 UAE-based
manufacturers selected by ADNOC to sign framework agreements valued at AED 6 billion—a major step
forward in advancing local manufacturing within the UAE.

[ [PSI Featured in KEZAD Group Spotlight] ][62]

## [PSI Featured in KEZAD Group Spotlight][63]

We’re proud to have been featured by KEZAD Group in their latest video spotlight—highlighting Polar
Specialized Industries (PSI) and the strategic advantage of our location near Khalifa Port, one of
the region’s most important logistics hubs.

[ [PSI Delivers First Flare Tip for Major OEM in the Middle East] ][64]

## [PSI Delivers First Flare Tip for Major OEM in the Middle East][65]

We’re proud to announce a significant milestone in our manufacturing capabilities—PSI has
successfully fabricated a Flare Tip for a leading Flare System OEM in the Middle East.

## What Are Shipping Containers?

A shipping container is a durable steel unit built to endure transport, storage, and
long-term use across Australia’s harsh conditions. From compact 10ft units to full-size 40ft
High Cube containers, they’re engineered for intermodal freight — moving seamlessly between
ships, trains, and road transport without unloading. Whether you need secure on-site storage,
a converted office, or a custom build, our containers meet Australian standards and arrive
ready for your project.

**Privacy Commitment**
We protect your personal information in accordance with the Privacy Act 1988 (Cth) and the
Australian Privacy Principles (APPs). See our full Privacy Policy for details on how we collect,
store, and use your data.

## Our Commitment to Sustainability

We are deeply committed to environmental sustainability. Our containers are intentionally designed
using responsibly sourced materials and offer eco-friendly features such as solar panels, green
roofing, and other innovative solutions. Dedicated to reducing our carbon footprint, we strive to
help you do the same.

## Solutions Built for You

We specialize in tailoring shipping and storage containers to meet your specific needs. From mobile
offices and pop-up shops to custom storage solutions, our expert team turns containers into
functional, innovative designs—built precisely for you.

## How Are Shipping Containers Typically Used?

Shipping containers are incredibly versatile. Our customers use them for construction storage,
farming, container homes and ADUs, portable offices, retail shops, cold chain logistics, hazmat
storage, and freight shipping. Whatever your project, there’s a container grade and configuration to
fit.

partners, and communities the world over.  Using our unique capabilities in complex ocean
infrastructure development, we’re driving innovation for a just transition and a better blue
tomorrow.

# Welcome to SES Energy

For more than 40 years, SES Energy has provided safe, cost-effective and reliable services to the
global energy industry, on a sustainable basis enabling our customers to succeed in the
ever-changing environment.

## One partner, more solutions

We are delighted to announce that CIU (Chemical Injection Services Ltd) are the latest to join the
SES Energy group, bringing with them their expert team and renowned services quality - meaning we
can now offer a range of chemical injection services and corrosion monitoring.

We are growing our portfolio of mission critical services so we can better support our customers.
Our diverse range of inventory and services reduces the need for multiple suppliers: one call, one
contract, consistent performance.

By aligning people, assets and know how around your goal, we'll mobilise the right capabilities,
right when you need them - so you can focus on the job, not the supply chain.

redefine efficiency and reliability in the industry. Discover tailored offshore logistics, storage,
and transportation solutions that meet your evolving needs. Explore our vast range and experience

## Serving the Energy Space

Give us your challenge - we'll find the solution

## CIU (Chemical Injection Utilities Ltd) joins the SES Energy group

Chemical injection services and corrosion monitoring now added to our services, building on our
mission critical equipment and capabilities.

## Offshore Containers & Equipment

Integrated service and rental packages for the energy industry.

## Aviation & Refuelling Services

Full end-to-end service to keep your offshore Helicopter operations safe and compliant

## Chemical Services

Specialist chemical management solutions for the handling, storage, transportation and delivery of
high-value chemicals and essential oilfield fluids.

## Integrity Services

Keeping your equipment compliant and working at all time.

# Welcome to SES Energy

For more than 40 years, SES Energy has provided safe, cost-effective and reliable services to the
global energy industry, on a sustainable basis enabling our customers to succeed in the
ever-changing environment.

## One partner, more solutions

We are delighted to announce that CIU (Chemical Injection Services Ltd) are the latest to join the
SES Energy group, bringing with them their expert team and renowned services quality - meaning we
can now offer a range of chemical injection services and corrosion monitoring.

We are growing our portfolio of mission critical services so we can better support our customers.
Our diverse range of inventory and services reduces the need for multiple suppliers: one call, one
contract, consistent performance.

By aligning people, assets and know how around your goal, we'll mobilise the right capabilities,
right when you need them - so you can focus on the job, not the supply chain.

## Products

Welcome to the forefront of offshore container solutions. With a fleet of over 52,000 units
encompassing containers, baskets, skips, tanks, rigging lofts, and tubular handling systems, we
redefine efficiency and reliability in the industry. Discover tailored offshore logistics, storage,
and transportation solutions that meet your evolving needs. Explore our vast range and experience
excellence in offshore equipment services

We excel in offering a diverse selection of new and used ISO Shipping Containers, ideal for
customers seeking greater control over their cargo and aiming to avoid the demurrage fees associated
with carrier-owned containers.

Additionally, we are the premier provider of DNV 2.7-1 Certified Offshore Equipment in the Gulf
Coast region, meticulously engineered to meet the highest standards of the offshore industry.

Whether you need robust containers for industrial use or DNV 2.7-1 Certified Offshore Equipment for
offshore projects, Shipper Owned Container delivers exceptional products tailored to your specific
requirements.

Shipper Owned Container is your premier destination for top-quality shipping solutions.

[
][61]

Learn more

Founded in 2006 in Houston, TX, Shipper Owned Container began with a vision to provide ISO shipping
containers with an unwavering commitment to outstanding customer service. Our goal was to create a
container company that put the customer first, offering tailored solutions to meet diverse needs.
Whether you’re purchasing one container or a hundred, we strive to deliver a personalized experience
and ensure your satisfaction.

In 2009, recognizing the growing demand for specialized containers in the offshore industry, we
expanded our product offerings to include DNV 2.7-1 Certified Offshore Equipment. These robust and
reliable containers are specifically designed to withstand the challenging conditions of offshore
rig operations. This expansion allowed us to cater to a broader range of industries and further
solidify our reputation for quality and innovation.

Today, with locations in Texas and Louisiana, Shipper Owned Container is proud to be a trusted
partner for businesses across various sectors, providing top-quality equipment and unparalleled
customer service. Our dedication to excellence and continuous improvement drives us to meet and
exceed our clients’ expectations, ensuring that their cargo is protected and their needs are met
with precision and care.

Contact us today to learn more about our range of products and discover how we can serve your
containers needs.

Whether you need robust containers for industrial use or DNV 2.7-1 Certified Offshore Equipment for

Shipper Owned Container is your premier destination for top-quality shipping solutions.

[

Founded in 2006 in Houston, TX, Shipper Owned Container began with a vision to provide ISO shipping
containers with an unwavering commitment to outstanding customer service. Our goal was to create a
container company that put the customer first, offering tailored solutions to meet diverse needs.
Whether you’re purchasing one container or a hundred, we strive to deliver a personalized experience
and ensure your satisfaction.

In 2009, recognizing the growing demand for specialized containers in the offshore industry, we
expanded our product offerings to include DNV 2.7-1 Certified Offshore Equipment. These robust and
reliable containers are specifically designed to withstand the challenging conditions of offshore
rig operations. This expansion allowed us to cater to a broader range of industries and further
solidify our reputation for quality and innovation.

Today, with locations in Texas and Louisiana, Shipper Owned Container is proud to be a trusted
partner for businesses across various sectors, providing top-quality equipment and unparalleled
customer service. Our dedication to excellence and continuous improvement drives us to meet and
exceed our clients’ expectations, ensuring that their cargo is protected and their needs are met
with precision and care.

Contact us today to learn more about our range of products and discover how we can serve your

# Shipping Containers for Sale

[Shop Containers][25]

## Containers Direct is an award winning, nationwide supplier of shipping containers.

Containers Direct are one of the leading suppliers of shipping containers for sale including: [new
shipping containers][26], [used containers][27] and [converted containers][28]. One of the few
British manufacturers of [new build containers][29] and specialists in [container conversions][30],
from [container offices][31] to [storage containers][32] of all shapes and sizes including a wide
range of [flat pack containers][33]. Founded in 2008 the company rapidly gained a reputation for
innovation, leading the way in supplying cut price containers straight from the docks. The opening
of the fabrication depot in 2010 allowed new research and development of ways to re-purpose ISO
containers, bringing to the market a range of standard branded offices, gyms, classrooms and much
more. We pride ourselves on being one of the first container resellers to realise the full potential
of a container structure.

The shipping container itself has an interesting history. Invented by Malcom McClean in 1956, it was
a concept that massively reduced the costs of both shipping and transport, allowing Asia to become
the new workshop of the world. A key feature of the shipping container is that it's intermodal, i.e.
suitable for safe transportation on a wide variety of modes of transport. A container can be loaded
with goods on the back of a lorry in the Far East, lifted onto a train, moved onto a container ship
and arrive in a port in the UK to be trucked to a factory. Throughout this journey the doors are
only opened twice, once for loading and once for emptying. To endure shipment in harsh marine
environments, heavy handling in ports, depots and factories, shipping containers must be incredibly
strong. Containers are also reusable, so they must be durable enough to withstand this sort of rough
handling as they travel around the world for over a decade or more. Extreme resilience is needed for
loading with up to 27 tons of cargo and withstand stacking up to 9 containers high!
This enormous strength and durability makes them ideal for use as [storage containers][34] AND the
perfect structures for [converting][35] to suit a wide range of uses. The production of a shipping
container is carbon intensive so Containers Direct specialise in working with [second-hand shipping
containers][36] after they've been released from their working life on shipping fleets. They are
given a new lease of life by repurposing them with a low carbon footprint in our in-house depot.

We are well known for our [office containers][37], safe chemical stores and [pop up shops][38] for a
variety of applications, including burger and coffee bars and retail outlets. We create [joined-up
containers][39] to make larger spaces for use as classrooms, festival exhibition stands and [garage
containers][40]. We pioneered the **WideLine®** [extra wide shipping container][41]. [Living
roof][42] - a valuable part of a conversion project in capturing carbon and increasing
bio-diversity. This is now available as a stand-alone product..

# Shipping Containers for Sale

[Shop Containers][25]

## Containers Direct is an award winning, nationwide supplier of shipping containers.

Containers Direct are one of the leading suppliers of shipping containers for sale including: [new
shipping containers][26], [used containers][27] and [converted containers][28]. One of the few
British manufacturers of [new build containers][29] and specialists in [container conversions][30],
from [container offices][31] to [storage containers][32] of all shapes and sizes including a wide
range of [flat pack containers][33]. Founded in 2008 the company rapidly gained a reputation for
innovation, leading the way in supplying cut price containers straight from the docks. The opening
of the fabrication depot in 2010 allowed new research and development of ways to re-purpose ISO
containers, bringing to the market a range of standard branded offices, gyms, classrooms and much
more. We pride ourselves on being one of the first container resellers to realise the full potential
of a container structure.

The shipping container itself has an interesting history. Invented by Malcom McClean in 1956, it was
a concept that massively reduced the costs of both shipping and transport, allowing Asia to become
the new workshop of the world. A key feature of the shipping container is that it's intermodal, i.e.
suitable for safe transportation on a wide variety of modes of transport. A container can be loaded
with goods on the back of a lorry in the Far East, lifted onto a train, moved onto a container ship
and arrive in a port in the UK to be trucked to a factory. Throughout this journey the doors are
only opened twice, once for loading and once for emptying. To endure shipment in harsh marine
environments, heavy handling in ports, depots and factories, shipping containers must be incredibly
strong. Containers are also reusable, so they must be durable enough to withstand this sort of rough
handling as they travel around the world for over a decade or more. Extreme resilience is needed for
loading with up to 27 tons of cargo and withstand stacking up to 9 containers high!
This enormous strength and durability makes them ideal for use as [storage containers][34] AND the
perfect structures for [converting][35] to suit a wide range of uses. The production of a shipping
container is carbon intensive so Containers Direct specialise in working with [second-hand shipping
containers][36] after they've been released from their working life on shipping fleets. They are
given a new lease of life by repurposing them with a low carbon footprint in our in-house depot.

We are well known for our [office containers][37], safe chemical stores and [pop up shops][38] for a
variety of applications, including burger and coffee bars and retail outlets. We create [joined-up
containers][39] to make larger spaces for use as classrooms, festival exhibition stands and [garage
containers][40]. We pioneered the **WideLine®** [extra wide shipping container][41]. [Living
roof][42] - a valuable part of a conversion project in capturing carbon and increasing
bio-diversity. This is now available as a stand-alone product..

### [20ft therapy space][87]

Based on our popular ModiBox® portable office design, this tranquil oasis tucked away between the
trees, is located on Bath City Farm. Used as a therapy in nature space we used wood cladding to
cover the front of the shipping container and repainted the remainder green, to blend in nicely with
its surroundings. Lined and insulated inside, for temperature and sound control, it will provide
comfort and privacy for its users all year round. The patio style doors and turn and tilt widows are
optional upgrades to our standard ModiBox® features, adding a sleek and professional appearance and
letting plenty of light inside for a bright and airy ambience.

## Navigate change. Decode demand. Grow with confidence.

Markets are changing faster than most planning cycles. Technology, regulation, supply chain shocks
and shifting customer expectations are rewriting the rules across every sector.

Strategic Revenue Insights gives leaders a clear view of where demand is heading, how value pools
are shifting and which bets matter most. We combine rigorous research with practical advisory so
your next move is grounded in evidence, not instinct.

## Our Strategic Process

We connect market signals to revenue decisions through a simple, repeatable flow.

### Market Signals

Track macro trends, policy shifts, technology disruption and competitive moves.

### Strategic Insights

Convert data into clear narratives on risk, growth pockets and profit pools.

### Actionable Strategies

Translate insight into prioritised initiatives, investments and go to market plays.

Strategic Revenue Insights delivers precise market sizing and forecasting that cut through
uncertainty and reveal measurable opportunity. Using rigorous data, cross-industry expertise, and
scenario-based models, we help organizations understand market potential, anticipate shifts, and
make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

Robust models that quantify market size, growth and segment level outlook over five to ten years. We
stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

Our Competitive & Benchmarking Analysis gives leaders a clear, evidence-backed understanding of
where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple
lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

Clear views of how incumbents and disruptors are positioned. We map portfolios, pricing, innovation
focus, channel strategies and financial performance to show where you stand and where gaps exist.

segments, routes to market, and opportunities that matter most-helping organizations sharpen their

Granular understanding of how customers discover, select, purchase and use products and services

As your dedicated shipping container supplier, we take pride in delivering the ideal container
solutions for all your personal, commercial, and intermodal needs. At Tradecorp, we offer a
comprehensive range of shipping containers for sale, from new to pre-owned options, each equipped
with unique features to match your specific requirements.

## Why Choose Tradecorp for Your Shipping Container Needs?

At Tradecorp, our mission is to provide high-quality and customized container solutions that save
you both time and money. Whether you’re looking to buy a used shipping container for personal
storage or need a specialized high cube unit for business purposes, our inventory covers every need.
* **Nationwide Availability:** Shipping containers are available across the U.S.
* **Competitive Pricing: **Save money on shipping containers that fit your budget.
* **Tailored Solutions: **From design to delivery, we customize every container to your
  specifications.

## Explore Our Product Range

Our inventory includes a diverse selection of new and used shipping containers in various sizes and
configurations to suit a wide range of applications, such as storage space, office space, and more.

At Tradecorp, we provide an array of services to support your container needs:

solutions, while our rental service is designed for short-term storage needs.

Our container offices offer a cost-effective solution for small business owners needing office space
in remote or challenging locations.

**3. Temporary Fencing and Porta Potty Rental**

We supply additional rental services, including temporary fencing and porta-potty units, to support
construction and event needs.

**4. Refrigerated and Insulated Containers**

Our insulated containers provide controlled environments suitable for temperature-sensitive goods.

**5. Local Storage Units**

Our local storage units offer practical storage solutions for businesses and homeowners in need of
reliable, watertight storage containers.

cryogenic systems for diverse industries worldwide.

## skilled team members manufacture vessels to be delivered to our customers all around the world.

vessels, ISO containers and road tankers amongst others. These are joined by an ever-increasing
